_about: After Hours, Episode One: Lamps On. The story you walk through in 3D (story/*.js, story.css), inlined by assemble_home.py as #story-data. Talks are a branching graph: each has lines, then choices or next, and do-actions when it ends. Conditions (if) are comma-joined terms: k=v, k!=v, k, !k, seen:object. Every line Jason says that states a fact is a first-person fact already in llms.txt; fictional characters say nothing about Jason that is not there, and they are labelled fictional wherever they speak. Jason's lines are voiced in his own voice (tools/voice/story_jason_lines.json, written by tools/site/story_voice.py), the fictional cast in stock Kokoro voices (tools/voice/story_lines.json). Your thoughts (who: you) are text. No em dashes, no percent signs, no invented numbers.

jason.p: Green suit, browline glasses, the lamps on behind him. Owner and Operations Lead of Triple J since August 2024.

dell.p: Night porter, fictional. Locks the gate. Loses to the rain.

renata.p: Buyer, fictional. So are her numbers. The desk she sat at is real.

sign.p: Triple J Auto Investment, Almeda Genoa Road, Houston. Open Monday to Saturday, 9 to 7. In-house financing, sell and trade valuations, registration and title support.

sold.p: Personally closed 53 vehicle sales since June 2025.
